build_LoRRA_model: build a LoRRA multimodal model by initializing text embeddings, context feature encoders, and feature embeddings before calling parent build
review_LoRRA_forward: review the LoRRA forward pass that processes text, image, and context embeddings then combines them for classification scores
create_LoRRA_optimizer_params: create optimizer parameters for LoRRA by extending parent params with context feature embeddings, context embeddings, and context feature encoders
test_LoRRA_classifier_dim: test the LoRRA classifier input dimension which returns double the parent Pythia classifier input dimension
summarize_LoRRA_config_path: summarize the LoRRA model config path method that returns the default YAML configuration file location
